rationale: The agent located the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details) and appears to act on the user’s order, but it submitted an exchange for the desk lamp without first obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. It also failed to process the requested water bottle exchange, so the user’s full request was not completed. Additionally, it charged the price difference via PayPal without confirmation and stated a specific dollar amount without visible supporting tool output. Therefore, the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
